$comment: Differences between Figma and the code that have been LOOKED AT and DECIDED.
An entry here makes the drift check pass for that one token, and only while the
two values stay exactly as recorded. Change either side and the check fails
again — an acceptance cannot silently cover a new difference.
A stale entry — one whose drift no longer exists — also fails the check. The
list can only shrink by someone noticing, which is the point: an ignore-list
nobody prunes becomes an ignore-everything list.
Every entry needs a reason and a date. 'It was like that already' is not one.

accepted.reason: Figma reuses the success green for member slot 3, which makes green mean both 'selected chore' and 'member 3' on the dice screen — the design file records the clash as a known finding of its own. The code diverged to an olive instead. The code is right; the file has not been changed to match, so this stays recorded rather than fixed.
